blocks.tamil_translation: just as we fast, (but) they give charity and we are not able to give charity; they free slaves, and that is not possible for us,” said the Sahabah. The Prophet ﷺ asked, “Shall I teach you a deed by which you may catch up with those who have gone ahead of you in deeds, and get ahead of those who come after you, and by which no one can become better than you unless he does deeds like yours?” The Sahabah requested, “O Rasulullah! Please do tell us.” The Prophet ﷺ said, “After every Salah recite “Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar”, each one 33 times.” (They began to act accordingly. But when the well-off Sahabah came to know what the Prophet ﷺ had taught, they too began to act on it.) Again the poor Muhajirin came and said, “Our well-off brothers too have heard of this, and they too have begun to act in the same way!” The Prophet ﷺ said, “This is the grace of Allah; He gives it to whomever He wills.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ سَبَّحَ اللهَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثاً وَّ ثَلَاثِينَ وَحَمِدَ اللهَ ثَلَاثاً وَّ ثَلَاثِينَ وَكَبَّرَ اللهَ ثَلَاثاً وَّثَلَاثِينَ فَتِلْكَ تِسْعَةٌ وَّ تِسْعُونَ، وَقَالَ تَمَامَ الْمِائَةِ: لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَي كُلِّ شَيْيءٍ قَدِيرٌ غُفِرَتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب استحباب الذكر بعد الصلاة وبيان صفته رقم:١٣٥٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever, after every Salah, recites Subhanallah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times and Allahu Akbar 33 times — these make 99 — and to complete
